inputs.original_text: This is how institutions handle dissent: NBC turns “F*** Joe Biden!” into “Let’s go Brandon!”, then schools and courts decide even the cleaned-up version is too dangerous to wear. The two Michigan brothers taking their case to the U.S. Supreme Court are exposing the real issue: officials decide which political messages are acceptable, and “protecting students” becomes a convenient excuse to silence messages they can’t control.
inputs.modified_text: NBC turned “F*** Joe Biden!” into “Let’s go Brandon!”, but schools and courts still decided the cleaned-up version was too dangerous to wear. The two Michigan brothers taking their case to the U.S. Supreme Court are highlighting the real issue: officials decide which political messages are acceptable, and “protecting students” can become an excuse to silence messages they can’t control.
